description.pve:
While in combat, the Moon will cycle through its phases every 5s. There are 8 Moon phases.

Starting from a New Moon, all damage you deal will be Amplified by 5%. The value of the Amplifier will increase by 5% each phase until reaching 25% during a Full Moon, then it will decrease as the Moon return to being a New Moon, restarting the cycle.

During a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for 10s.
